stock.description: Aux Electric Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the production, commercialization, and promotion of air conditioning units. Its comprehensive product range features a variety of climate control solutions, including wall-mounted, vertical cabinet, and central residential air conditioners, as well as light and heavy-duty commercial air conditioning systems, commercial heat pumps, and specialized project installations. These products are distributed under the widely recognized AUX brand, with sales primarily conducted through a network of retail establishments. Founded in 1994, the company maintains its headquarters in Ningbo, China, and functions as a subsidiary of the larger entity, AUX Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
